rulings_in_order: Ruling: apply one consolidated feature-only delta to frozen dev on a fresh branch, preserving the original reviewed branch — excludes the43unrelated earlier local docs commits while keeping the complete feature/design/baseline result — cost if wrong: a current-dev seam may need additional repair, so integration receives new owner tests and review.

Ruling: retain native agent_chat_start outside queue-owned Stop-parent eligibility and refuse an unsupported automatic follow-up — the approved contract is one immediate bounded turn and current Stop scheduler requires exact queue custody; its chain ID is not allowance authority — cost if wrong: a user expecting such hook follow-ups needs a separately qualified extension, rather than an implicit allowance reset.

Ruling: original QA archives keep their exact pre-dev content/versions/results; new current-dev evidence is separate — preserves trace integrity and avoids silently relabeling v19/v74 evidence as v22/v76 qualification — cost if wrong: readers must follow the current QA summary to distinguish historical and integrated results.

Ruling: preserve current-dev gated provider/model/preset routing in prepared new_chat, using destination defaults as the base and retaining existing routing refusal/parameter semantics — shipping conditional schema already advertises these fields and dropping them would silently regress ADR-147; exact resolved selection is captured and disclosed before approval — cost if wrong: explicit routing can differ from destination default provider/model, so disclosure and durable snapshot controls must qualify the override.

Ruling: preserve and separately disclose the two unchanged dev test exclusions while requiring all21 recorded baseline nodes and all affected executed cases to pass — the diagnostic skip depends on unavailable historical Git objects, and the strict timer XFAIL records an existing bare-screen harness limitation; neither is a newly skipped failure or successful qualification — cost if wrong: the excluded timer scenario remains unverified by that node, so actual mounted coverage and independent review must assess feature behavior.

Ruling: restore the existing spend spec at the readiness boundary: unaccepted optimistic rows stay outside Context and Current, and actual send admission cancels the pending idle refresh — the same shipped spec explicitly defines both behaviors; frozen-dev reproduction establishes inherited provenance but does not excuse the timer defect — cost if wrong: readiness display or idle rearming may need refinement, so the complete cost owner and accepted/refused controls must pass.

Ruling: move the unmerged design, foundation and feature task chain together to the freshly swept IDs 34201/34202/34203 (including feature subtasks), preserving the landed TASK33802 census — moving only the design above its existing dependents would reverse the required dependency ordering — cost if wrong: historical task identifiers need the explicit current QA identity map; historical archives remain unchanged.

Ruling: publish the user-authorized PR as a draft and keep TASK34203.2 In Progress, with residual I2 explicitly blocking readiness — the final-review skill cap allows one consolidated repair and one scoped review; the remaining navigation-versus-authored-revision defect is real and load-bearing, so it cannot be silently treated as fixed — cost if wrong: the prompt can still be presented twice after caret-only movement, and repair plus scoped qualification are required before readiness.

Ruling: move the still-unpublished chain from34201/34202/34203 to freshly swept34213/34214/34215, including feature subtasks, preserving the other owner of34201 — the publication sweep discovered a new competing Anthropic Settings task; all-ref historical maximum and93worktrees confirm the replacement block was free at allocation — cost if wrong: readers need both historical identity maps, and another concurrent collision would require reconciliation before readiness.
